title: Indian Overseas Bank IOB Local Bank Officer Admit Card 2026

fullContentHtml:
📢 Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) Local Bank Officer Admit Card 2026 Out

Indian Overseas Bank (IOB), a premier Public Sector Bank, has released the online examination Call Letter for the post of Local Bank Officer (LBO) in JMGS-I (2026–2027). Registered candidates can download their hall ticket using their Registration Number and Password / Date of Birth from the official IBPS portal before 29 September 2026.

📅 Important Dates

  • Call Letter Download Start Date: 17 September 2026
  • Call Letter Download Last Date: 29 September 2026
  • Online Examination Date: 29 September 2026
  • Selection Stages: Online Examination followed by Interview and Document Verification.

📥 How to Download IOB Local Bank Officer Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official recruitment portal or click on the direct Call Letter download link in the Important Links table below.
  2. Select language (English / Hindi).
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Roll Number and Password / Date of Birth (DD-MM-YYYY).
  4. Enter the Captcha Code displayed on screen and click on Login.
  5. Your IOB LBO Admit Card 2026 will appear on screen.
  6. Download and print 2 copies of the call letter. Make sure to carry a valid original photo ID proof and passport-size photographs to the exam hall.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q1. What is the exam date for IOB Local Bank Officer 2026?

The online written test will be conducted on 29 September 2026.

Q2. What is the last date to download the IOB LBO Call Letter?

Candidates can download their admit card till 29 September 2026.

Q3. What documents are required at the exam centre?

Printed copy of Call Letter with affixed photograph, original Photo ID proof (Aadhaar / PAN / Voter ID / Passport) and a photocopy of the ID proof.
